_villages.75: READ 21 September 2026 at 4x from dist.jpg: the Pagus heading is written VERTICALLY in the left margin and reads «Vivoz» with a macron over the o — «Vivõz» — written twice, on two successive openings. A shorter word stands above it, «Sched…»/«Scheiz…», not read out. NOT IDENTIFIED with a modern settlement, deliberately: in this book a final z renders č («Ottosaz» is Otočac), so the name is not what it looks like in Latin letters, and this archive does not guess a village.
